title: BIM 室內裝修協調｜衝突在模型裡被找到，不在工地｜惠強 HQ Design
desc: 撞管誰付錢？惠強在 BIM 協調階段把建築、機電、設備與現場條件整合於同一套模型，衝突在進場前辨識而非在工地發現。了解整合對象與你拿到什麼。
lede: 衝突在模型裡被找到，不在工地被找到。設計、機電、設備與現場條件先在同一套模型中整合。
gloss: BIM Coordination — architecture, MEP, equipment and site conditions integrated in one model; clashes identified before construction.
inp: 定案設計與技術驗證結論、機電／消防／IT／保全等指定廠商圖面、大樓既有系統資料。
out: 整合後的 BIM 模型、衝突清單與解決方案、與模型一致的報價依據，交 06 施工圖說。
q: 進場後才發現風管撞到樑、灑水頭撞到燈，誰付錢、誰延誤？
quote: 惠強室內裝修（HQ Design）在 BIM 協調階段將建築、機電、設備與現場條件整合於同一套模型，使跨專業衝突在進場前被辨識，而非在工地被發現。CAD→BIM 與 BIM 報價整合兩項自 2026 年 4 月起導入。
quote2: 一般流程中問題常在現場才被發現，返工與工期風險由業主承擔；BIM 協調把發現階段提前到進場前，模型、圖面與報價依據也更容易維持一致。
qen: Design, MEP, equipment and site conditions are coordinated in one model, so conflicts surface early — reducing rework and information gaps.
how_h2: 惠強室內裝修在 BIM 協調階段做哪四件事？
how: 建築、機電、設備與專業界面整合於同一套模型，而非各自維護的圖面。
整合對象 4 類：建築、機電（MEP）、設備、專業界面（公司簡介協作流程 03 BIM Coordination）。
風管與樑、灑水頭與燈具、設備與淨高等衝突在模型中標記並解決。
發現階段：進場前。對照一般流程「問題常在現場才被發現」（公司簡介 The Difference）。
建築、機電、IT／保全與業主指定廠商的界面在模型中協調，責任邊界在施工前釐清。
2025 年 SECOM 南港總部 5,940 sqm：高度保全需求的企業總部，保全與營運系統界面於施工前協調。
報價依據由模型而來，模型改、數量改、報價改，三者一致。
2026 年 4 月導入項目之一，與 CAD→BIM、參數化多方案並列。
cap: 建築、機電、設備三層在同一套模型中疊合；貫穿三層的虛線於機電層標記衝突點——在模型中辨識，而非在工地。示意圖，不含特定案件衝突數。
why_h2: BIM 協調對業主的意義是什麼？
why: 細節與責任界面在施工前被釐清。
跨專業衝突可在進場前被發現。
模型、圖面與報價依據更容易維持一致。

ev.t: 中興保全 SECOM 南港總部
ev.claim_t: 技術協調：建築、機電、IT／保全與指定廠商界面
ev.claim: 在持續營運且具高度保全需求的企業總部中，協調施工區隔、保全與營運系統界面，完成接待、開放辦公、會議與主管空間的整合翻新；零重大缺失驗收。

titleEn: BIM Coordination — clashes found in the model, not on site
descEn: Who pays when a duct hits a beam? HQ Design integrates architecture, MEP, equipment and site conditions in one model, so clashes surface before anyone enters the site.
h1En: Who pays for the clash, and when is it found?
ledeEn: Clashes are found in the model, not on site. Design, MEP, equipment and site conditions are integrated in one model first.
inpEn: Settled design and technical validation conclusions, drawings from nominated MEP, fire, IT and security contractors, and existing building system data.
outEn: The integrated BIM model, a clash list with resolutions, and a pricing basis consistent with the model, passed to stage 06 Construction Documentation.
howH2En: What does HQ Design do during BIM coordination?
whyH2En: What does BIM coordination mean for the owner?
howEn: Architecture, MEP, equipment and specialist interfaces are integrated in one model rather than kept as separately maintained drawings.
Ducts against beams, sprinkler heads against light fittings, equipment against clear height — these are marked and resolved in the model.
Interfaces with architecture, MEP, IT and security, and with the owner's nominated contractors, are coordinated in the model, so responsibility boundaries are clear before construction.
The pricing basis comes from the model: change the model, the quantities change, and the price changes with them.
whyEn: Design intent that can be built
Details and responsibility boundaries are clarified before construction.
Cross-discipline clashes can be found before work starts on site.
Model, drawings and the pricing basis are easier to keep consistent.
evFootEn: This page does not publish clash counts for named projects. HQ Design has not released those figures; they will be added once compiled, rather than substituted with estimates.
figAltEn: BIM coordination diagram: architecture, MEP and equipment are overlaid as three layers in one model, with cross-layer clash points marked before work starts on site.
